text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The desire to run "for someone else's 
sake" makes Biko Pegasus stronger. 
Inspired by this, Sakura Bakushin O has 
rekindled her burning spirit!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Through fierce competition, Biko Pegasus 
reshaped her ideal of what kind of hero 
she wanted to be: not just someone strong, 
but "a hero who can save someone."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She recalls Shinko Windy's struggle: ever 
since attempting to bite during a race, 
she has been a constant laughingstock.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus decides to race on dirt to 
save Shinko Windy. Having run only on turf 
recently, she feels a bit uneasy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even so, answering the call for help is 
what a hero does. The next target is the 
February Stakes.
